title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and harden audit logging for data residency compliance. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require guarantees that KMS keys and associated encryption operations cannot be routed outside a pinned region and that all key-access events are captured in the audit stream. This change folds together policy enforcement, diagnostic telemetry, and migration tooling: 1) add RBAC v2 policy check for KMS key region pinning with explicit deny semantics when a policy exists; 2) augment audit logging to include KMS key ARN, resolved region, policy id, and decision reason; 3) introduce a migration job that audits existing vault bindings and emits a Linear ticket for manual review when a binding lacks explicit region metadata; 4) add CI policy checks and unit/integration tests. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only until rollout flag is enabled by ops. Rollout plan: staged rollout over two weeks starting with internal orgs, then a canary set of customers, then global enforcement; followups will add UI surface in Console for policy authoring. See linked Linear tasks and SUP ticket for customer requests. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration tests added, [x] policy unit test matrix expanded, [x] migration job included, [x] docs stubbed in docs/security. How to test locally: use test-kms emulator, apply rbac v2 policy fixture, run migration dry-run. Rollback: flip enforcement flag in config or revert merge. Related work: ENG-2142, SEC-97, SUP-2241.
